info.title: Avi JWTServerProfile Object API
info.description:
Avi JWTServerProfile object api
```
- configure jwtserverprofile <key>
- show jwtserverprofile <key>
```

API permission: PERMISSION_JWTSERVERPROFILE

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: object name

parameters.name: refers_to
parameters.description: Filter to request all objects that refers to another Avi resource. Its syntax is refers_to=<obj_type>:<obj_uuid>. Eg. get all virtual services referring to pool p1 will be refers_to=pool:pool_p1_uuid

parameters.name: referred_by
parameters.description: Filter to request all objects that are referred by another Avi resource. Its syntax is referred_by=<obj_type>:<obj_uuid>. Eg. get all pools referred_by virtual service vs1 - referred_by=virtualservice:vs_vs1_uuid

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: List of fields to be returned for the resource. Some fields like name, URL, uuid etc. are always returned.

parameters.name: include_name
parameters.description: All the Avi REST reference URIs have a name suffix as URI#name. It is useful to get the referenced resource name without performing get on that object.

parameters.name: skip_default
parameters.description: Default values are not set.

parameters.name: join_subresources
parameters.description: It automatically returns additional dependent resources like runtime. Eg. join_subresources=runtime.

parameters.description: Avi Tenant Header UUID

parameters.name: X-Avi-Version
parameters.description: The caller is required to set Avi Version Header to the expected version of configuration. The response from the controller will provide and accept data according to the specified version. The controller will reject POST and PUT requests where the data is not compatible with the specified version.

parameters.name: X-CSRFToken
parameters.description: Avi Controller may send back CSRF token in the response cookies. The caller should update the request headers with this token else controller will reject requests.

symmetric_jwks_keys.description: Symmetric keys used for signing/validating the JWT, only allowed with profile_type CONTROLLER_INTERNAL_AUTH. Field introduced in 20.1.6. Minimum of 1 items required. Maximum of 1 items allowed. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

alg.description: Algorithm that need to be used while signing/validation, allowed values  HS256, HS384, HS512. Field introduced in 20.1.6. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

key.description: Secret JWK for signing/validation, length of the key varies depending upon the type of algorithm used for key generation {HS256  32 bytes, HS384  48bytes, HS512  64 bytes}. Field introduced in 20.1.6. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

kid.description: Unique key id across all keys. Field introduced in 20.1.6. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

kty.description: Secret key type/format, allowed value  octet(oct). Field introduced in 20.1.6. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

authorization_servers.description: List of authorization server issuer URLs that can issue tokens for this protected resource. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Maximum of 1 items allowed. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

enable_protected_resource_metadata.description: Enable OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728) support. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

metadata_url_path.description: URL path where OAuth 2.0 protected resource metadata is published. This is relative to the Virtual Service. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

resource_documentation.description: URL of documentation for this protected resource. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

supported_scopes.description: List of OAuth 2.0 scopes supported by this protected resource. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Maximum of 20 items allowed. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

_last_modified.description: UNIX time since epoch in microseconds. Units(MICROSECONDS).

controller_internal_auth.description: JWT Auth configuration for profile_type CONTROLLER_INTERNAL_AUTH. Field introduced in 20.1.6. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

is_federated.description: This field describes the object's replication scope. If the field is set to false, then the object is visible within the controller-cluster.  If the field is set to true, then the object is replicated across the federation.  . Field introduced in 20.1.6. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

issuer.description: Uniquely identifiable name of the Token Issuer, only allowed with profile_type CLIENT_AUTH. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

jwks_keys.description: JWKS key set used for validating the JWT, only allowed with profile_type CLIENT_AUTH. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

jwt_profile_type.description: Type of JWT Server profile which defines the usage type. Enum options - CLIENT_AUTH, CONTROLLER_INTERNAL_AUTH. Field introduced in 20.1.6. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

name.description: Name of the JWT Profile. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

protected_resource_config.description: OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata configuration (RFC 9728). Only applicable when jwt_profile_type is CLIENT_AUTH. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

tenant_ref.description: UUID of the Tenant. It is a reference to an object of type Tenant. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

uuid.description: UUID of the JWTProfile. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.
